definitions.gloss: one and only; unique; unparalleled; incomparable
definitions.explanation: Describes something or someone that is absolutely singular, with no equal or equivalent. A four-character compound emphasizing absolute uniqueness.

examples.japanese: {唯一無二|ゆいいつむに}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧だ。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{唯一無二|ゆいいつむに}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: His talent is said to be unparalleled.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{唯一無二|ゆいいつむに}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: This temple is known as a truly unique piece of architecture in the world.

notes:
A four-character compound (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) composed of ⟦{唯一|ゆいいつ}→唯一：01666_yuiitsu⟧ (only one) + ⟦{無二|むに}→無二：24982_muni⟧ (without a second). The two halves reinforce each other to emphasize absolute uniqueness — there is only one and no second exists.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {唯一無二|ゆいいつむに}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧ (one-of-a-kind existence)
- {唯一無二|ゆいいつむに}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧ (unparalleled talent)
- {唯一無二|ゆいいつむに}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{親友|しんゆう}→親友：03266_shinyuu⟧ (irreplaceable best friend)
- {唯一無二|ゆいいつむに}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧ (unique work of art)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{唯一|ゆいいつ}→唯一：01666_yuiitsu⟧ — the only one; simpler and more common, without the emphatic reinforcement
- ⟦{独自|どくじ}→独自：05614_dokuji⟧ — original, unique; focuses on being distinctive rather than being the sole one
- ⟦かけがえのない→かけがえのない：10328_kakegaenonai⟧ — irreplaceable; more emotional and personal in tone

USAGE:
This is a literary and emphatic expression. It is common in speeches, writing, and media when praising something as extraordinary. In everyday conversation, ⟦{唯一|ゆいいつ}→唯一：01666_yuiitsu⟧ alone is more common, while {唯一無二|ゆいいつむに} adds rhetorical weight.
